user.title: Connect BLUETTI on your local network
user.description: Verified read-only support for Elite 30 V2 (EL30V2). The UPS must reach this receiver and the router must direct only the BLUETTI data connection here. Reserve the UPS IP address in DHCP. Sensors become unavailable after 90 seconds without a valid sample. No cloud account or Bluetooth is required.
